meta.name: azure-storage
meta.description: Azure Storage Services including Blob Storage, File Shares, Queue Storage, Table Storage, and Data Lake. Answers questions about storage access tiers (hot, cool, cold, archive), when to use each tier, and tier comparison. Provides object storage, SMB file shares, async messaging, NoSQL key-value, and big data analytics. Includes lifecycle management. USE FOR: blob storage, file shares, queue storage, table storage, data lake, upload files, download blobs, storage accounts, access tiers, storage tiers, hot cool cold archive, storage tier comparison, when to use storage tiers, lifecycle management, Azure Storage concepts. DO NOT USE FOR: SQL databases, Cosmos DB (use azure-prepare), messaging with Event Hubs or Service Bus (use azure-messaging).

copy.tagline: 弄清云存储服务种类,按用途选对存储方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果创建云应用时拿不准数据该存在哪种存储服务里
copy.tagline_en: Know Azure storage services and pick the right one for your data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up a cloud app and aren't sure which Azure storage option fits your data

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可解答 Azure 存储问题：各存储类型（Blob、文件共享、队列、表格、数据湖）的用途，以及 hot/cool/cold/archive 访问层怎么选；配置好账户后还能列出容器、上传或下载 Blob。
howto.when: 当你提到 Blob、访问层、文件共享等 Azure 存储话题，或要求上传/下载、列出容器时触发。不适用于 SQL、Cosmos DB、Event Hubs 等话题。

say.text: hot/cool/cold/archive 这几档访问层怎么选？
say.note: Claude 会按使用频率和成本说明。

say.text: 帮我把本地文件上传到 Blob 容器。
say.note: 账户配置好会让 Claude 执行上传或给命令。

say.text: Blob 存储和文件共享有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会对比用途和访问方式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer Azure Storage questions: the purposes of storage types (Blob, File Shares, Queue, Table, Data Lake), how to choose hot, cool, cold, and archive access tiers, and can list containers or upload/download blobs once an account is configured.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Azure Storage topics such as Blob, access tiers, or file shares, or ask to upload/download files or list containers. It is not for SQL, Cosmos DB, or Event Hubs topics.

say_en.text: How do I choose among hot, cool, cold, and archive access tiers?
say_en.note: Claude explains based on usage frequency and cost.

say_en.text: Upload this local file to a blob container.
say_en.note: Claude uploads it or gives the command if set up.

say_en.text: What's the difference between Blob storage and File Shares?
say_en.note: Claude compares use cases and access methods.
